title: Ankle injury at a sports competition
setting: Busy sporting event. 24M, tripped during a football match, twisting his ankle. Sitting on the ground, won't weight-bear, in obvious pain.
verdictExplanation: Alert, airway clear, breathing and circulation normal. An isolated, painful soft-tissue ankle injury with no red flags. Injured but not sick: treat on scene.

history.history: Injury moments ago, no pop heard

followUp.question: What is your first-line management?

options.text: Rest, ice, comfortable support and elevation; reassess
Strap firmly and send him back onto the pitch
Apply a tourniquet above the ankle

followUp.explanation: Soft-tissue injuries are managed with rest, ice, comfortable support and elevation, plus reassessment. This patient is not sick, so 999 is not indicated. Returning to play risks worsening the injury, and a tourniquet is only for life-threatening limb haemorrhage.

levelExplanation.er: Offer appropriate analgesia within your scope and reassess pain after treatment.

levelFlags.erNotes: Discharge with advice may be appropriate if pain controlled and able to mobilise; otherwise arrange onward care.
